articles.title: CleanSpark misses Wall Street revenue estimates as shares sink
articles.summary: CleanSpark’s shares fell 5.5% on Thursday after the Bitcoin miner reported $138 million in quarterly revenue, narrowly missing Wall Street’s consensus estimate.

articles.title: 人工智能被用於設計全新病毒
articles.summary: 科學家利用人工智慧設計了16種成功的病毒，這些病毒的基因序列都是由人工智慧設計的。

articles.title: Coldcard fallout shows up onchain as 210,000 bitcoin leaves old wallets
articles.summary: Roughly 200,000 bitcoin have moved from long-term holder wallets in the past week, suggesting a possible shift in custody rather than conventional selling

articles.title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
articles.summary: The ruling is in addition to $375m in fines Meta was already ordered to pay in the case, for a total of $942m.
